decisions.reason: The cleaning soap gained its own page in 2024, which signals results at or above aspiration, and it fits the firm's care-product offer at low cost.
The maintenance oil is a low-cost complement to oiled floors that supports customer relationships, and it shows no shortfall large enough to trigger search for other uses of its resources.
The care line was promoted to a dedicated page, which indicates satisfactory performance against aspiration and a strategic fit with the floor offer.
The moisture-protection underlay is a standard accessory sold alongside the floors with little separate resource demand, so the firm's slack easily carries it.
The high-density underlay overlaps somewhat with the other underlay and gets only modest visibility, but its accessory role and low cost make dropping it unlikely.
The oak parquet line sits at the core of the firm's established business, and its continued presence suggests acceptable results, so dropping it would be unusual.
